props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons or links rendered in a container at the end of the alert, before the close button.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render as.

props.name: children
props.description: Free-form content rendered in the content area after the title and description.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: closable
props.description:
Whether to show a dismiss button at the end of the alert. Clicking it sets the open state to
`false`, which plays the exit animation and then removes the alert from the DOM.

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Icon name shown inside the dismiss button. Only used when `closable` is `true`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled default open state.

props.name: description
props.description:
Supporting text rendered under the title. Its presence switches the alert to the multi-line
layout (larger icon); `children` render after it.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Whether to display as an edge-to-edge banner with flat borders.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Leading icon displayed in the alert.
- `undefined` (default): automatically resolves to the semantic icon of the `type` (`info`,
  `success`, `warning`, `error`), or none for `default`.
- `false` or `null`: hides the icon.
- `IconT.Name`: displays the specified icon shortcut (e.g. `'icon-tip'`) or custom JSX element.

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description:
Called once after the alert closed, its CSS exit animation (if any) has finished, and the
element has been removed from the DOM.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called with the next open state when the user dismisses the alert through the close button.
It is not called when `open` is changed from outside.

props.name: open
props.description:
Controlled open state. Leave `undefined` for uncontrolled usage. A closed alert is removed
from the DOM after its exit animation, so it renders nothing.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: title
props.description: Primary title, rendered in bold above the description. Nothing is rendered when empty.

props.name: translations
props.description:
Overrides the built-in strings for this instance, merged over the provider locale. The only
key is `close`, the accessible label of the dismiss button (default `'Close alert'`).
examples:
import { Alert } from 'moraine'

<Alert closable title="Saved" translations={{ close: 'Dismiss' }} />

props.name: type
props.description: Semantic intent of the alert.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual surface variant.
